// A position in a local tangent frame anchored at Origin: East and North lie
// in the local horizontal plane, Up is along the ellipsoid normal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_tangent_plane_coordinates)
type EnuCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    East: Length;
    North: Length;
    Up: Length;
    Origin: GeoCoordinate;
}
